test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Debashish Panda was recently appointed as the chief of ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**IRDAI.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Debasish Panda** has been appointed to the** position of Chairperson of the IRDAI** with the approval of the **Cabinet's Appointments Committee.**
 
• He is a retired** IAS officer.**
 
• He is a former **DFS Secretary **
 
• He was initially appointed for a** three-year term.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SEBI:**

 
 
• SEBI stands for** Securities and Exchange Board of India.**
 
• **Formed: **April 12, 1988

 **Headquarters:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

 **Chairman: **Madhabi Puri Buch
 
 
 
• **IL&FS:**
 
 
• IL&FS stands for **Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited.**
 
• **Founded:** 1987

 **Headquarters:** Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

 **CEO: **Arun K. Saha
 
 
 
• **IRDAI:**
 
 
• IRDAI stands for **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India.**
 
• **Founded: **1999

 **Headquarters: **Hyderabad

 **Chairperson:** Debasish Panda
 
 
 
• **ICAR:**
 
 
• **ICAR **stands for** Indian Council of Agricultural Research**.
 
• **Founded:** 16 July 1929

 **Director:** Himanshu Pathak

 **President:** Minister of Agriculture
 
 

***All information as of March 2023***
